walkthroughs.body_html:
Conflict & Tension between East & West 1945-1972 — a core area of GCSE History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Conflict & Tension between East & West 1945-1972 brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Conflict & Tension between East & West 1945-1972.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How many days did the 1967 war last?

options: Stalin started it by invading Eastern Europe after the war.
Vesalius invented the microscope.
It began when the USSR shot down a US spy plane.
Ideological incompatibility plus mutual suspicion after WWII — disputes over Eastern Europe, the atomic bomb, and broken wartime agreements.
